Standard: Multi-tenant cloud service; choose the data-centre region at tenancy set-up
Notes: SAP publishes the data-centre list in its trust-centre reports; confirm the current list and your residency rule before contract

Standard: Independent attestation reports (SOC 1, C5) from the vendor
Notes: Request the latest report and review its scope and exclusions

Standard: SAML 2.0 single sign-on; role-based access; named users
Notes: Separate roles for auditor, analyst, process owner and administrator

Standard: Encrypted transfer (TLS); read-only technical user in the source
Notes: No write-back to the source system

Standard: Pseudonymise user IDs and vendor identifiers before load; keep the key in the source domain
Notes: Re-identify only in the source domain, for an approved investigation

Standard: Activity, timestamp and case or object identifiers; object-centric model for P2P
Notes: Keep object types and relationships in the data dictionary

Standard: CSV or Parquet with a run manifest and row counts
Notes: Parquet for volume; CSV for simplicity

Standard: BPMN 2.0 for the target model; DMN for decision rules where used
Assistive; answers grounded in the data; human decision on every deviation
Notes: Beta and roadmap features are not dependencies; check the monthly AI usage allowance

Standard: Evidence retained per audit-record policy [retention period]
Notes: Set in the evidence repository, not in the mining tool
